cross_field_rules: Unknown fields are rejected everywhere in a runnable request.
Relative paths resolve relative to the request file.
steps must be unique and ordered build_r0, invert, albedo, interpolate.
interpolate is reserved but rejected because Phase F is not implemented.
build_r0 requires r0.mode=build, a sensor-appropriate recipe, and r0_source inputs.
invert requires reflectance inputs, an r0 section, and a LUT named inversion_lut.
Selected albedo operations require their named LUT and ancillary inputs.
A tiled static context root advertises supported ancillary and static-mask names during schema validation; discovery and preflight verify actual per-tile cardinality.
update_atomically is supported only for standalone albedo on an existing raw product.
A custom execution profile must supply both resources.cluster and resources.partition.
Explicit tile routing requires profiles, tile_profiles, and coordinator_profile; tile_profiles must exactly cover selection.tiles.
All routed profiles in one operational request must use the same Slurm cluster and environment.
Legacy profile, max_concurrent_tasks, and resources fields cannot be combined with explicit tile routing.
Staging root is required when staging is enabled.
Input filename identities must agree with explicitly declared tile, date, water_year, and product.
R0 start_date and end_date must be supplied together.
For a complete water year, dates=[] means all discovered files in the selected water year; it does not assert that every calendar date exists.

No automatic bootstrap, cron installation, schema migration or full-history replay.

lut.description: Reflectance LUT in evaluated band order I1/I2/I3/M2/M4/M8/M11.

preparation.description: Scene preparation options; see retrieval_preparation. Must use post_inversion clouds.

axes.description: x and y mapped_field bindings for the exact native grid.

ancillary.description: Mapped canopy_fraction, slope, aspect, ice_fraction required by retained retrieval.

background.description: baseline mapped_field with trailing band axis; optionally screened plus index as a pair.

source.description: Required by direct retrieve; filled from inventory by prepare_date.

clouds.description: Each value contains cloud and context GeoTIFF paths for the same-day domain; coordinator supplies it.

prepared_context.description: day_context digest for the complete same-day source inventory; coordinator supplies it.

notes: Source, clouds and prepared_context are mandatory when calling retrieve directly.
Solver 6, max_eval=200 and initial radius=250 micrometres are fixed by this worker; generic daily tuning fields are not accepted alternatives.

date.description: Must equal native source acquisition date.

fields.description: Required raw_snow_fraction, canopy_adjusted_fsca, screening_flags, qa_qf1, qa_qf7, sensor_zenith, grain_radius, dust, solar_zenith, solar_azimuth mapped fields; additionally exactly one of swir_flags or swir_score, or spectral reconstruction.

clouds.description: cloud/context paths, including available neighboring tiles.

spectral.description: Original spectral reconstruction evidence, see spectral_reconstruction.

output.description: Required by universal prepare jobs; standalone nrt prepare uses --output.

sse.description: Original spectral sum of squared errors; reconstructed fit must agree.

screened_background.description: Alternative original background, paired with screen_used.

screen_used.description: Boolean per-pixel alternative background selection, paired with screened_background.

bytes.description: File size from stat; not user-estimated.

source_stream.description: standard or nrt, derived from product.

prepared.description: Generated prepared_daily bindings on retrieval receipt.

notes: Create with source_record rather than hand-editing stat fields. Acquisition/archive controllers may attach additional provenance such as cmr_updated or origin; those are not deployment knobs.

working_days.description: Bounded working inventory retention; must be at least 66 days.

unresolved_warning_days.description: Age at which unresolved NRT-to-standard dates warn.

warning_bytes.description: Category-to-byte warning thresholds; warnings are not transfer permission or a hard byte cap.

growth_warning_bytes.description: Inventory growth warning threshold; 0 disables this warning.

archive_root.description: Durable archive; default STREAM_ROOT/archive. Cannot change in place once published. Must not overlap mutable workspaces.
Existing product input directory; files organized by tile/year.

script_root.description: Fresh output directory for coverage report and interactive download scripts.

notes: Standalone external acquisition utility, not a universal workflow job kind.
Default command only inspects local presence; --query writes scripts after CMR lookup, never downloads/submits.

bands.description: Ordered bands. Omit for labeled R0 products; positional GeoTIFF R0 inputs require an explicit list.

lut_file.description: Optional LUT used to infer band selection; the retained worker explicitly fixes its evaluated bands.

cloud_mask_source.description: External cloud source; the retained coordinator overrides this with its matched corrected cloud.

cloud_mask_var.description: Dataset variable for an external cloud mask.

cloud_shadow_mask_var.description: Dataset variable for an external cloud-shadow mask.

cloud_mask_source_policy.description: How external/native QA cloud evidence is combined; see supported enum.

cloud_mask_application_stage.description: Pre- versus post-inversion cloud application. Retained VIIRS retrieval requires post_inversion.

keep_intermediate_reflectance.description: Retain intermediate reflectance arrays if true.

keep_r0_masks.description: Retain R0 masks; the retained worker forces true.

max_solar_zenith.description: Maximum valid solar zenith angle in physical degrees.

min_obs_1km.description: Minimum M-band observation count required by VIIRS preparation.

min_obs_500m.description: Minimum I-band observation count required by VIIRS preparation.

mask_water_using_reflectance_qf.description: Use native reflectance QA to identify water.

mask_water_using_external_file.description: Use an externally supplied water layer where bound.

mask_low_reflectance_for_inversion.description: Enable the optional low-reflectance inversion exclusion.

low_reflectance_threshold.description: Reflectance cutoff if low-reflectance masking is enabled.

notes: JSON recipes use path strings for external sources, not Python Dataset objects.
source and logger are API arguments, not recipe fields. Retained worker forces evaluated bands, keep_r0_masks=true and its cloud_mask_source; cloud_mask_application_stage must be post_inversion.

safety: Planning a universal workflow does not download or compute; nrt cycle without --execute DOES acquire, prepare clouds and retrieve before stopping at the revision plan.
JSON has no comments. Do not paste this reference's description/type/default wrappers into a runnable request.
Scientific recipe constants are not user-adjustable JSON options. Only evaluated NOAA-20 viirs_snow interpolation is enabled.
R0 loads every summer scene for a tile/year into RAM; zarr_path, zarr_mode and chunks are rejected.
Full-history NRT replay stops with status 3 and a transfer-size report instead of silently staging all history.
Use exclusive full-node blanca-snow allocations for high-memory R0; other work uses blanca-snow/blanca-rittger and approved preemptable overflow with the verified exclusion list.
Runtime dictionary parsers do not all reject unknown keys. This reference documents consumed keys, not a promise of complete machine validation.
